visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a dynamic digital map animation zooming from a satellite view of East Asia down to the streets of Taichung, Taiwan, specifically showing Henan Road Section 3. The interface mimics a navigation app with various location pins visible. (2) Transition to a real-world outdoor setting in a park with lush green trees and modern high-rise buildings in the background. Two young men are present; one wears a black and white Flash Wolves esports jersey with a Red Bull logo, and the other wears a white t-shirt. Both wear pixelated sunglasses. (3) The man in the jersey holds out a black box with gold lettering that reads 'CHAMPIONSHIP COMMEMORATIVE MEDAL'. The camera provides close-up shots of both individuals. (4) The two men stand together on a paved path, gesturing toward the camera as text overlays appear. The lighting is bright natural daylight, and the environment is a well-maintained urban green space.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: Two young Asian men. One is wearing a professional esports jersey with 'FLASH WOLVES' and 'Red Bull' logos. The other wears a white graphic t-shirt. Both are wearing 'thug life' style pixelated sunglasses.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Starts with a digital map interface showing Taichung city layout. Later shifts to a real outdoor park with grass, trees, park benches, and modern metropolitan buildings in the distance.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a gentle, rhythmic piano track playing a bright and positive melody in a major key. The recording quality is very high, with a clean frequency spectrum. There are no vocal elements initially. (2) As the music continues, a male voice enters at a moderate volume. The speech is clear and articulate, delivered with a friendly, inviting tone. The speaker announces the availability of championship commemorative merchandise. (3) A second male voice briefly joins, confirming that stock is ready and urging viewers to act quickly as items are limited. The piano BGM remains steady in the background, eventually fading out smoothly as the clip ends.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Location Reveal -> Product Showcase -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional advertisement for 'Flash Wolves' esports team championship commemorative merchandise. It uses a map-based hook to locate the team in Taichung and then features team members presenting the limited-edition products in a friendly, local park setting to encourage fan purchases.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of branded products, team jerseys, and verbal call to purchase merchandise.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively bridges the digital gaming identity of the team with a real-world physical location in Taichung, creating a sense of local pride and authenticity for the merchandise promotion.
